prompt: What is penetration depth in quantum mechanics and how is it defined
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 directly and correctly defines penetration depth in the tunneling/forbidden-region sense as the e-folding (1/κ) decay length of the wavefunction into a classically forbidden region. Candidate 4 gives a related formula but conflates “skin depth” with quantum penetration depth and inconsistently describes decay of probability density as 1/e while using d=1/κ (which would correspond to wavefunction 1/e). Candidate 2 misidentifies penetration depth with electron mean free path and mixes unrelated contexts, and Candidate 3 provides an incorrect, nonstandard formula tied to a square-well/binding-energy model rather than the usual κ-based tunneling definition.
